description: This PHP source file defines the ConfigFileAPI class, which manages REST API endpoints related to configuration file writing, database connection validation, and registration data handling during an installation or upgrade process of OrangeHRM. It extends an abstract REST controller and interacts with various utilities and external systems.

classes.name: ConfigFileAPI
classes.description: API controller class for handling configuration file writing, database connection checks, and registration event handling during installation or upgrade processes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes utility properties for data registration and system configuration.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Processes POST requests to write configuration files and verify database connection; also handles registration data submission.

methods.name: sendRegistrationData
methods.description: Sends registration data, saving registration events and updates system configuration accordingly.

methods.name: getRegistrationType
methods.description: Returns the registration type identifier for upgrader start.
